# Observation viewer vectors

The owning `observation_view` tests regenerate ordinary v8 and durable v2
recordings in memory through the production writers on every test run. The same
two completions carry root/child Prepared anchors in durable mode. No stored tape
fixture needs a manual binary edit. The `.view.json` and `.perfetto.json` goldens
use archival capture name `fixture`; the tests replace their encoding-specific
SHA-256 and valid-byte fields with those of the regenerated bytes before comparing
the semantic view. Tests truncate these recordings and damage interior bytes.

The thread instant vector is adapted from Perfetto commit
`c7b436451a48ccd264cd8abe4e968ca6a191c88f`,
`src/trace_processor/export_json_unittest.cc`, `InstantEventOnThread` (lines 920–950).
It retains `ph: I`, `s: t`, explicit pid/tid and a timestamp coordinate. Here that
coordinate is visibly logical order, without a measured duration. Perfetto's
`protos/perfetto/trace/track_event/track_event.proto`, lines 134–156, describes why
begin/end pairs on one track imply nesting; these fixtures use only instants.
